notes.title: Battle special conditions update
notes.content: [p]I've just released another small update for the demo! Until now, most battles felt quite similar, and many of you likely stuck with just one weapon. That’s about to change — from now on, many encounters come with special conditions that grant bonuses or penalties to certain skills.[/p][p]For example, fighting in a shield wall formation gives you a bonus to shield and spear skills. So be sure to adapt — swap your weapon to match the situation and make the most of every battle![/p]
